offering_description.value: Supplies rail and infrastructure products and services to railroads, transit agencies and contractors in North America. It manufactures and sources track components, friction management and inspection systems, and precast concrete products, and provides rail services and engineering support.

primary_products.value: rail and track components; friction management products; rail inspection and monitoring systems; precast concrete products; coated pipe products

primary_services.value: rail services; track engineering; inspection and monitoring services; construction services

customer_segment.value: B2B: Class I and short-line railroads, rail contractors, utilities and construction firms; B2G: Transit agencies and public infrastructure owners

end_markets.value: rail transportation; transit; utilities; construction and infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: rail components, friction management products, inspection equipment and precast concrete sold to customers; service fees: rail services, inspection and monitoring, and field support; project or contract: infrastructure construction and engineered rail projects bid by contract
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes precast concrete and engineered rail products, sold to railroads and contractors; distributor: resells purchased rail materials and components to railroads and contractors; service provider: provides rail services and field work for railroad and transit owners

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with plants and service locations across multiple states and provinces

specialization.value: related lines: rail products and services, friction management, inspection technology, and infrastructure construction products sharing rail customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to railroads, transit agencies and contractors; own locations: manufacturing plants, distribution yards and rail service sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: rail safety and track standards, environmental and hazardous materials rules, and workplace safety requirements from FRA, DOT and OSHA

notes: Segment structure and the exact product lines may have changed recently with divestitures, so details are approximate.
